Name: (FS) Vanilla Shirts for Soft Farmer
Author: trulyvivid
Description:
[img]https://file.garden/ZTAYtbuhKl19Vtxs/mod%20assets/stardew%20valley/description.png[/img]

[i]Pretty simple; a Fashion Sense pack that includes a fair few vanilla shirts, made to fit the "Soft Farmer" mod. These should be compatible with all 3 body types (Robust, Classic and Soft). I've also included some extra masculine versions of a few tops that only have feminine versions in the original mods.[/i]

[b]Notes;
[/b]
[list]
[*]﻿This pack is an adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23568]"Vanilla Shirts for Fashion Sense"[/url]﻿ , made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TeddyIsTired?gameId=1303]TeddyIsTired[/url]﻿ . As such, it [i]only[/i] includes vanilla shirts that are included in the base pack, though I may add more according to suggestions or my own interest. I will also update the pack if any additions are made to the base pack.
[*]This pack is intended for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]"Soft Farmer - A Cute Vanilla-Style Overhaul"[/url]﻿ , made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Crisaius?gameId=1303]Crisaius[/url] . If you install it without installing Soft Farmer, the game [i]won't break[/i], but the shirts will be [i]visually incompatible [/i]with the vanilla farmer's body and other body retextures
[/list]

[img]https://file.garden/ZTAYtbuhKl19Vtxs/mod%20assets/stardew%20valley/credits.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TeddyIsTired?gameId=1303]TeddyIsTired[/url] for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23568]"Vanilla Shirts for Fashion Sense"[/url] which I used as a template for this pack
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Crisaius?gameId=1303]Crisaius[/url] for allowing me to use assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]"Soft Farmer - A Cute Vanilla-Style Overhaul"[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd?gameId=1303]PeacefulEnd[/url]﻿ for creating [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿, the framework this pack relies on
[/list]
I've tried to iron out any issues, but if you notice anything please report it in the 'Bugs' section.
